entities.name: Étienne Clavière
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Étienne Clavière was a Genevan-born French financier and politician of the French Revolution. He was the French Minister of Finance between 24 March and 12 June 1792, and again between 10 August 1792 and 2 June 1793.
